sampling.split_policy: unchanged normalized-SHA256 train<.8, validation<.9, else test
sampling.selection_bias: bounded prefix expansion of four of 64 shards; not a uniform full-corpus draw

preprocessing.document_boundary: tokenize each document independently, append one EOS, nonoverlapping full chunks, discard suffix
preprocessing.global_exact_duplicate_policy: keep first encountered retained document; reject all subsequent matches
preprocessing.token_chunk_duplicate_policy: global exact SHA256 over little-endian uint32 IDs; retain first

near_duplicate_policy.action: reject whole source document if any full chunk reaches threshold; refill from same fixed hash split

document_chunk_cap.sampling: uniform without replacement, sort original source chunk indices
document_chunk_cap.last_document: uniformly select min(cap, remaining quota) chunks
document_chunk_cap.decontamination_order: reject whole document using all full chunks before capped sampling
